header: Plays Mario Kart 64 the way a player starts it, for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs: the title, then A pressed
through the menus to a 50cc Grand Prix's first race (Mushroom Cup, Luigi Raceway), driven by the game's kart AI
(tools/shader_survey.js's autopilot()), then the cup as a player goes on with it: each race put on its last lap
(lastLap()), its finish and results passed with A until the next course is loaded, and that one driven 40 s too, to
Moo Moo Farm and Koopa Troopa Beach. The AI drives, so nothing here is timed on the game's clock.
